Name: Remove Animal Limitations
Author: Hacknet
Description:
All animals can be purchased from Marnie regardless of which size coop or barn you have.
Requires SMAPI. Also uses Harmony to overwrite the purchasable animal screen, so it may conflict with any mods that modify that screen by adding or removing animals. (Content patcher mods that update the visuals of animals should work fine.)

Manifest.Name: RemoveAnimalLimitations
Manifest.Description: Removes need to upgrade barn/coop to purchase higher tier animals.
Manifest.Author: Hobbes
